caseNameFull: In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF Pamela Bruce STUART.

opinions.text:
In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF Pamela Bruce STUART.

Pamela Bruce Stuart, of Washington, District of Columbia, is suspended from the practice of law in this Court and a rule will issue, returnable within 40 days, requiring her to show cause why she should not be disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
